_doc: Enemy kinds (design/combat/enemy-combat-spec.md §2-§4, §6.4; build item N-6.1). tiers: the size of the numbers by tier (enemy spec §3); `break` is the Break meter's size (0: no meter, any hit staggers it). break: each hit adds `per_impact` × its Impact, +`behind` from behind and +`windup` while it winds up; full, the enemy is Broken for `broken_s` (by tier): it can't act and takes `broken_damage` × damage; the meter drains `drain`/s after `drain_after` s without a hit. director: at most `melee` melee and `ranged` ranged enemies may start an attack on you at once, and none further than `reach` px from you (the off-screen rule). states (N-6.2, enemy spec §5): fire that hits a unit whose body catches (data/materials.json fire × body) sets it burning for `burn_s` (× `tier_k` for big ones), `burn_dps` every `tick` s; flesh catches only when oiled (tar, `oil_s`), and oil makes it burn `oil_k` × as hard; a burning unit lights the ground it stands on and any husk within `spread_r`; water puts it out; `panic` factions run from you while they burn. guide (N-6.5, enemy spec §12.1): the Field Guide. Each kind is Seen when it comes into a fight, Beaten when killed or it yields, its weakness Found when you do one of its `answers` to it (named in `guide.answers`; the lesson then shows), and Mastered once beaten `master_n` times with its weakness found. morale (N-6.4, enemy spec §6.5): a unit of one of `factions` gives up at `yield_at` of its HP once its leader (a kind with `leader`) is down or `half_out` of its side is out of the fight; Minions run for `flee_s` s and are gone, the rest kneel, out of the fight, and are spared if you win. kinds: one record per kind: faction, role, tier, attack (melee, ranged; duel, boss and none kinds aren't counted by the director), body material (data/materials.json: Hollows are husks, cloth; Silas and brigands flesh; the Warden iron; an ember is fire and takes no states), the lesson it teaches, then its numbers (hp, poise, speed, radius, damage, windup, reach or range, cooldown, xp, and per-kind keys). New Hollows (N-6.3, enemy spec §8.1): the Lantern-eater walks to a lit lamp within `seek_r` and smothers it over `smother_s` s (a hit above its Focus stops it), then fights like a Hollow; the Hollow Choir keeps `keep` off and hums: Hollows within `hum_r` get +`poise_up` Poise and ×`speed_k` speed; a hit above its Focus hushes it for `hush_s` s; the Overdrawn Husk throws a wild ember bolt (`wild` radians off) and when Broken leaks a pool of Aether (`leak`: `aether` in all, `rate`/s to you while you stand in it, for `life` s). Brigands (N-6.3, enemy spec §8.2): a Cutthroat stabs, lunges and backs off for `back_off` s; a Crossbowman shoots a `shot_kind` bolt of `impact` and stands `reload` s after each; a Shieldman's `guard` stops hits from within `arc` degrees of his front up to Impact `stops_impact`, and fire on it burns the shield away; a Powder Monkey throws a `pot` (a circle that lands after `flight` s) and carries a `keg` that blows when fire finds him; the Brigand Captain swings with `impact`, throws a `net` (a shot that roots you for `root` s; Blink gets you out) and calls a `volley` every `every` s (his Crossbowmen shoot at once, past the director). armour (N-6.6, enemy spec §5.3): a kind's `armour` layer takes hits first. A hit at or above its `grade` in Impact goes fully through; below it only `through` of the damage does. Either way the layer loses the full damage (× `broken_k` while the wearer is Broken) from its `hp`; at 0 it is sundered: it falls away, the wearer is plain flesh and its Break meter gains `sunder_break` of its size. Metal armour (mail, plate) lets lightning straight through and counts as wet for a Spark's chain; fire heats it for `heat_s` s: `heat_dps` a second that armour doesn't stop, and hot plate is −1 Poise. Knights (N-6.6, enemy spec §8.3): the Oath Squire fights in mail; the Shieldknight's `guard` is iron (fire doesn't burn it, lightning goes through it) and he keeps `wall` px from other Shieldknights as he advances, side by side; the heavy shield turns only `turn` degrees a second, so you can get round it; the Silencer keeps `keep` off and rings its `bell`: a circle of `r` px that lands after `windup` s and stops spells inside it for `hush_s` s (a cast you are winding there breaks); a hit of Impact `breaks_at` or more, or Breaking the Silencer, breaks the bell, and then it fights with its mace.

hollow.lesson: Light and fire control a crowd.
hollow.name: Dust Hollow

slinger.lesson: Close in, or keep a lamp between you.
slinger.name: Hollow Slinger

inverted.lesson: Its stones fly home: stand off its line, not out of its reach.
inverted.name: Backward Slinger

rival.lesson: A duel: read his wind-ups and break them.
rival.name: Silas Vane

ember.lesson: Fire barely touches it; water puts it out.
ember.name: Ember

lantern_eater.lesson: It eats the light. Relight the lamp, or keep it off.
lantern_eater.name: Lantern-eater

choir.lesson: It hums the others on. Break its hum, or burn the lot.
choir.name: Hollow Choir

husk.lesson: A wizard drained hollow. Break it and drink what leaks.
husk.name: Overdrawn Husk

cutthroat.lesson: Any hit drops him. Don't let three box you in.
cutthroat.name: Cutthroat

crossbowman.lesson: Ward the bolt, or close in while he reloads.
crossbowman.name: Crossbowman

shieldman.lesson: His shield stops what comes from the front. Burn it, or go round.
shieldman.name: Shieldman

powder_monkey.lesson: He carries a keg. Fire on him, and it goes up.
powder_monkey.name: Powder Monkey

brigand_captain.lesson: Bring him down, and the rest lose heart.
brigand_captain.name: Brigand Captain

oath_squire.lesson: Mail eats small spells. Hit harder than grade II, or send lightning through it.
oath_squire.name: Oath Squire

shieldknight.lesson: Fire won't burn an iron shield. Go round it, or let lightning find the plate.
shieldknight.name: Shieldknight

silencer.lesson: Its bell stops spells in a circle. Step out, or break the bell with a heavy blow.
silencer.name: Silencer

acolyte.lesson: The first one runs for help. Catch it before it's gone.
acolyte.name: Acolyte

saboteur.lesson: It splashes oil and lights it. Water on the oil before the fuse burns down.
saboteur.name: Saboteur
